stock.description: Tencent Music Entertainment Group (TME) is a prominent digital music and entertainment provider within the People's Republic of China, delivering a comprehensive suite of services including music streaming, online karaoke, and interactive live performances. Its core music platforms, such as QQ Music, Kugou Music, and Kuwo Music, enable users to discover and enjoy music in tailored ways. WeSing serves as a social karaoke application, allowing individuals to sing, interact with friends, share performances, and find new songs. TME also manages interactive live streaming channels like Kugou Live and Kuwo Live, which offer performers a platform to showcase their talents and engage directly with their audience. Additionally, Kuwo Changting provides a wide array of audio content, ranging from audiobooks and cross-talks to radio dramas and other entertainment genres. Beyond its digital services, the company distributes music-related merchandise, including headsets, smart speakers, and karaoke microphones, and offers online ticketing for music events. TME further collaborates with smart device and automotive manufacturers to integrate and operate music services on their products. Headquartered in Shenzhen, China, Tencent Music Entertainment Group maintains a strategic partnership with China Literature and operates as a subsidiary of Tencent Holdings Limited.
